text: {"lessons":["Selling part of Stock A after a large gain felt rewarding, but I should not let that satisfaction replace evaluating its prospects and my portfolio balance.","My account fell from its early high, and losses weigh heavily on me; I should tolerate normal fluctuations rather than make fear-driven trades.","I traded little and the account partly recovered by Period 10, reinforcing that I should make deliberate, diversified decisions instead of trading for activity."]}
